test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following events took place in the year 1856?

options.text: Tantya Tope was captured, tried to escape and was put to death.
Awadh was captured by the British East India Company.
Bahadur Shah Zafar was sent to Rangoon jail.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Awadh was captured by the British East India Company**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Company annexed the state of** Awadh in 1856** on the charges of **misgovernance** by the Nawab of Awadh.
 
• It was captured on the order of **Lord Dalhousie** under the **Doctrine of lapse**.
 
• **Wajid Ali Shah** was the ruler of Awadh during the annexation and was later deported to **Garden Reach in Metiabruz, Kolkata**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Doctrine of lapse**__

 __
 
• It is an **annexation policy**, that a princely state in which the ruler did not have a legal male heir would be annexed by the company.
 
• It was started by** Lord ****Dalhousie, then Governor General of India**.
 
• Annexed state- **Satara (1848), Jaitpur (1849), Sambalpur (1849), Bhagat 1850, Udaipur (1852), Jhansi (1853) and Nagpur (1854)**.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Events in 1856**__

 
 
• Passing of **Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act, 1856**.
 
• **Charles Canning **became the Governor General of India.
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** was born on 23 July 1856.
